bundle.longDescription: Z-GL Shadertoy is a real-time, offline-capable Shadertoy-compatible GLSL shader editor for Windows, featuring a Monaco-based code editor, full multipass rendering (Image, Buffer A-D, Cube, Sound), all standard Shadertoy iChannel inputs, and one-click shadertoy.com import/export.
